source: Reserved threshold-selection participants, starting waves 1–6, observed valid next-survey outcome; saved stage 8 calibrated predictions
selection_rule: First score at which cumulative participant-equal weight reaches 1/3 and 2/3; thresholds use scores/weights only, never outcome optimization. Equal scores stay together. Lower <= cut1; moderate cut1 < p <= cut2; higher p > cut2.
boundary_rule: lower: p<=cut1; moderate: cut1<p<=cut2; higher: p>cut2
caution: Project-defined relative groups in development data; not established medical cutoffs or independently validated risk categories.
